scale_note: Unchanged from r001: height 0.155 m is a chosen design value inside the reported S-CH19 mode (151-160 mm), not the 160 mm of specimen A 26 664; widths, bulge, rounding, lean/twist and colours are R. r002 changes only the hole: centre at 0.275 of the height below the top (O: BREZ-006 reading of the A 26 664 drawing, 0.27-0.28), 12 facets (R), and wear of the lower third of both mouths (M extent; width/depth R).

design_dimensions_m.qualification: Chosen design values, not measurements of a specimen. Height is selected inside the reported S-CH19 distribution (usually 0.14-0.17 m; mode 0.151-0.160 m, 13 of 39); widths are R (inside the brief's ±15% of ~0.09/~0.045 m).
design_dimensions_m.source: S-CH19 (Chvojka, Menšík, Šálková & Kuna 2019, Archeologické rozhledy 71(2): 267-308) §3.1, as summarised in content/research/next-batch/material-culture.md Key fact 1

metadata_notes.mass_kg_reported: Most frequent S-CH19 reconstructed-mass class is 1600-1800 g: 20 of 45 weights (a plurality, not a majority); reported range ~1230-2353 g. Metadata note only, not physics; not a property of this model.
metadata_notes.implied_mass_from_export: 819 cm3 exported body -> R sanity check only at an assumed 1.8-2.0 g/cm3; not an archaeological measurement; the 2149 g of A 26 664 is an authors' estimate for 100 % and is not used.
metadata_notes.perforation: S-CH19: weights are usually perforated with a single opening (mostly 11-20 mm); one documented exception from feature 12/06 has a double opening on one side. The single through-hole in this kit is an R design choice, not a universal claim.
metadata_notes.function: Unresolved in the source (S-CH19 pp. 291-292, 301): loom weight vs spit support; the authors read lower-hole wear as base-up tying for most pieces. r002 shows no cord, rod or loom.
metadata_notes.wear: S-CH19 Table 2, A 26 664: wear 'v dolní třetině (z obou stran)' (M, this specimen). Modelled as a widened, rounded lower third of both mouths. Extent along the opening = M; radial width (<=3 mm) and depth (6 mm) = R. The offset line under the hole on the drawing (BREZ-006: 0.5-0.6 cm, O, convention not explained by the authors) was NOT used for the size. No colour, gloss, firing or clay-residue change on the piece (not reported for A 26 664).
metadata_notes.name: Owner decision 2026-11-23: neutral in-game name 'závaží' (not 'tkalcovské závaží'). File names keep the r001 'loomweight' prefix as asset identifiers.

parts_and_uncertainties: Hole centre 0.275 of the height below the top: O (BREZ-006 reading of the A 26 664 drawing: ~4.4 of 16.0 cm, 0.27-0.28); inside the S-CH19 frame for the whole find (upper third to half height, mostly the upper/middle-third boundary; M).
Hole diameter 0.016 m round: unchanged R from r001. A 26 664 drawing gives a slightly vertical oval ~12.5 x 14 mm (O); not adopted (no decision).
Wear: lower third of the opening at both mouths = M (A 26 664, Tab. 2). Width <=3 mm, depth 6 mm, profile = R.
Body height 0.155 m and widths: unchanged r001 design values; A 26 664 is 160 mm high (M) and widest ~11.8 x 11.0 cm a quarter of the height above the base (O) — not adopted (no decision).
Top mark: the marked variant keeps the r001 single central dimple; A 26 664 has 4 dimples (M) — not adopted.
Colours, firing, gloss, clay residue: r001 atlas unchanged; nothing specific to A 26 664 is claimed.
Suspension mode and loom use: not established; nothing in the model implies a loom.
own_work_license: Unselected original project work; manager/owner decision
deviations: r002 regenerates only loomweight.glb and loomweight_marked.glb (the card BREZ-007 names these two as inputs). Fragment and deposit are not regenerated; they stay r001 with the r001 hole height.

Built with the bpy 5.0.1 module (uv) on Linux instead of Blender 5.2.3 used for r001 (Blender is not installed on this machine; precedent HOUSE-004 r002). The atlas is regenerated from the unchanged recipe and seed; pixel equality with r001 is in checks/atlas_vs_r001.json.
Village views (ortho 25/16), PERSON/POT/HOUSE scale stills and the 24-row GPU render-info probe were not redone: the body size is unchanged and the change is a hole detail; see CHECKS.md.
GPU captures were taken at the window size the compositor gave (logged in checks/godot_shot_log.json), not forced to 1280x800.
